name: Word or number slot roll

source.description: Three inspected references swap one word or number inside a still layout with a vertical roll (a slot, an odometer, a list scroller with a focused item).

technique: One slot of a sentence or figure rolls vertically to its next value while everything around it holds still, so the change itself is the message (what varies, what stays).
purpose: Show alternatives, growth or a list compactly; keep a headline stable while its key word changes.
visual_behaviour: The word scrolls up out of a one-line window as the next scrolls in, with a slight overshoot; widths re-centre the line.
mechanics: yPercent step of a masked column with back.out(1.5) over about 0.5 s; optional width tween so centred lines re-flow smoothly.

decomposition.timing: One roll per beat; each entry held at least about 0.6 s.

failure_modes: Entries changing faster than reading speed
Different word widths jumping without fit

limitations: Per-digit odometers (each digit its own column) are not built in; compose several rolls

provenance.observed: The last word of a line cycles through three nouns in a vertical roll (approx., from overview spacing).
A vertical list scrolls with the focused item at full strength and the others faded.
A figure counts up with rolling digits above a dotted globe (approx., from overview spacing).

evidence.notes: Make it move / land / matter re-centres around each word.

licensing_notes: Technique only, learned from user-supplied references (inspiration-only, rights unknown).
